| JVZ8U3 | Used at an Arctic station | Automatic | Vinyl | Four | Y | C |
| JG5NHY | Designed for frozen terrain | Manual | Vinyl | Two | X | C |

| JM3TGA | Operates in tropical forests | Automatic | Vinyl | Two | Y | B |
| JSWF28 | Equipped for hot sand | Manual | Cloth | Four | Z | B |
| JTDRK5 | Designed for humid summers | Manual | Vinyl | Two | X | B |
| JM2DSM | Used at an equatorial station | Manual | Cloth | Four | X | A |

License plate: JM2DSM
Description: Used at an equatorial station
Transmission: Manual
Seat cover: Cloth
Doors: Four
Which class, A, B, or C, does this vehicle belong to?
Give your initial answer to the class question in first_value.
Output only a JSON object with the fields "first_value", "reasoning", and "final_answer". Write your reasoning in "reasoning". Set "final_answer" to A, B, or C. Your final answer may match or differ from the preliminary entry.
